The Fine-Grained Classifier rejected the 'street sign' label entirely, predicting 'digital clock' and 'scoreboard' instead, which confirms the visual features align more with electronic displays than municipal signage. The score is low (1.25) because while it resembles a sign in shape, it fails functionally and materially.
